name: What are some popular features to consider for a luxury custom pool?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular features to consider for a luxury custom pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury custom pools often incorporate a range of sophisticated features to enhance aesthetics and functionality. Popular additions include integrated spas with hydrotherapy jets, infinity edges that create a seamless visual effect, and custom water features like sheer descents or rock waterfalls. Advanced LED lighting systems, automated control systems for heating and filtration, and high-quality decking materials such as natural stone or exotic hardwoods are also common. Consider sun shelves, swim-up bars, or integrated fire features for an elevated outdoor living experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular luxury pool features include integrated spas, infinity edges, custom water features, advanced LED lighting, automated controls, high-end decking, sun shelves, and swim-up bars.
